item.title: Celtic 3-1 Aberdeen | HIGHLIGHTS | William Hill Premiership (SPFL TV)
item.description: 12:00 AM Dec 22, 2025: A dominant display earned Wilfried Nancy his first win as Celtic manager. Benjamin Nygren opened the scoring for the hosts before Dylan Lobban was sent off for bringing down Daizen Maeda. Celtic dominated proceedings but couldn’t put away their chances and 10-men Aberdeen stunned the home crowd when Kenan Bilalovic slotted home an equaliser.
